# gws CLI: Workspace Events reference (subscriptions)

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the Google Workspace Events API reference for the `gws` CLI: subscriptions create/delete/get/list/patch/reactivate, plus streaming and long-running operations. Read the title carefully: this is NOT Google Calendar events — it's the Workspace Events API (event subscriptions, e.g. react to new Chat messages), an entirely new service in the catalog with no overlap with the `gws-calendar*` fiches of lot 33 or any agenda recipe. Its `+subscribe` and `+renew` companions are listed separately (`googleworkspace-cli-gws-events-subscribe`, `googleworkspace-cli-gws-events-renew`). The event-driven building block of the CLI for agents that react to changes. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the events API generally needs a paid Google Workspace account; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
